doors.note: WordPress home page: "XL Bears is a Seattle social group for bears and bear admirers" with an "Upcoming Events" blurb list stating cadences in prose (Game Night [2nd Sundays], Spa Day [3rd Saturdays], XL Bear Bust [4th Fridays] …) but no dates of its own.

Embeds the group's public Google Calendar (src=xl.bears.seattle@gmail.com) and publishes its iCal address verbatim: https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/xl.bears.seattle@gmail.com/public/basic.ics.

doors.truthFlag: 152 VEVENTs, no paging; 148 ended more than 30 days before recon
doors.note: The calendar's public iCalendar export (text/calendar). Wall-clock DTSTART with TZID, monthly RRULEs for the standing socials, LOCATION as "Venue, street, city". Read by the scraper as a machine door; the archive is dropped.

recon.notes: Recon from one cached read of each door on 2026-09-20. 152 VEVENTs: 148 archive, 3 live series, 0 upcoming singles, 1 recent past singles, 0 series with nothing in the window.

coverage.basis: Feed door: the iCalendar export read whole. Every record live on 2026-09-20 is documented — series as ONE entry each with the rule's dates in the window, dated records as singles. 148 archive records and 1 recent past singles are counted as past listings. The rendered Google Calendar embed was not read (JavaScript); the iCalendar is the same calendar.
